exams.name: CLEP American Government
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test on US constitutional government, institutions, civil liberties and political behaviour, usually worth three college credits.

exams.name: CLEP American Literature
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test covering American prose, poetry and drama from the colonial period to the present, usually worth three college credits.

exams.name: CLEP Analyzing and Interpreting Literature
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test using passages from American and British literature to assess close reading, interpretation and literary terminology.

exams.name: CLEP Biology
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test covering molecular and cellular biology, organismal biology and population biology, commonly worth six college credits.

exams.name: CLEP Calculus
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test weighted about 60 percent limits and differential calculus and 40 percent integral calculus, typically worth four credits.

exams.name: CLEP Chemistry
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test covering the content of a full year of general chemistry, including stoichiometry, bonding, equilibrium and thermodynamics.

exams.name: CLEP College Algebra
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test on algebraic operations, equations, inequalities, functions and their graphs at one-semester college algebra level.

exams.name: CLEP College Composition
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam writing test combining multiple-choice questions with two essays scored by College Board readers, often worth six credits.

exams.name: CLEP College Composition Modular
exams.blurb: Multiple-choice version of the CLEP composition exam that lets institutions add their own locally scored essay component if they wish.

exams.name: CLEP College Mathematics
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test of quantitative literacy for non-mathematics majors, covering logic, sets, probability, statistics and financial mathematics.

exams.name: CLEP English Literature
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test focused on major British authors and works from Beowulf to the twentieth century, usually worth three college credits.

exams.name: CLEP Financial Accounting
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test on the accounting cycle, financial statements, assets, liabilities and equity taught in introductory financial accounting.

exams.name: CLEP French Language
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test of French listening and reading that can award Level 1 or Level 2 credit depending on the score achieved.

exams.name: CLEP German Language
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test of German listening and reading comprehension awarding Level 1 or Level 2 college credit based on the score band reached.

exams.name: CLEP History of the United States I: Early Colonization to 1877
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test covering US history from early European colonisation through the Civil War and the end of Reconstruction in 1877.

exams.name: CLEP History of the United States II: 1865 to the Present
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test covering US history from the end of the Civil War through industrialisation, the world wars and the modern era.

exams.name: CLEP Human Growth and Development
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test on theories and research in physical, cognitive and social development across the human lifespan.

exams.name: CLEP Humanities
exams.blurb: Broad credit-by-exam test of general knowledge in literature, visual art, music, philosophy and the performing arts from classical to modern times.

exams.name: CLEP Information Systems
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test on hardware, software, networks, databases, security and the role of information systems in business organisations.

exams.name: CLEP Introduction to Educational Psychology
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test on cognition, child development, teaching methods, motivation and classroom assessment for education majors.

exams.name: CLEP Introductory Business Law
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test covering contracts, torts, agency, the history and sources of American law and the legal environment of business.

exams.name: CLEP Introductory Psychology
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test of the facts, concepts and accepted principles taught in a one-semester introductory college psychology course.

exams.name: CLEP Introductory Sociology
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test covering social institutions, stratification, culture, deviance and sociological research methods and theory.

exams.name: CLEP Natural Sciences
exams.blurb: Survey credit-by-exam test for non-science majors spanning biological and physical sciences, commonly worth six college credits.

exams.name: CLEP Precalculus
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test of algebraic, exponential, logarithmic and trigonometric functions and their properties, graphs and applications.

exams.name: CLEP Principles of Macroeconomics
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test covering aggregate demand and supply, national income accounting, inflation, unemployment and monetary and fiscal policy.

exams.name: CLEP Principles of Management
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test on planning, organising, leading and controlling, human resources and operational aspects of management.

exams.name: CLEP Principles of Marketing
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test on consumer and organisational markets, segmentation, marketing strategy and the four elements of the marketing mix.

exams.name: CLEP Principles of Microeconomics
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test on the economic principles governing individual consumers and firms, market structures, pricing and factor markets.

exams.name: CLEP Social Sciences and History
exams.blurb: Broad credit-by-exam test spanning history, economics, government, geography, sociology, psychology and anthropology, often worth six credits.

exams.name: CLEP Spanish Language
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test of Spanish listening and reading comprehension awarding Level 1 or Level 2 college credit based on score.

exams.name: CLEP Spanish with Writing
exams.blurb: Extended CLEP Spanish exam that adds scored writing tasks to the listening and reading sections for higher-level language credit.

exams.name: CLEP Western Civilization I: Ancient Near East to 1648
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test covering the ancient Near East, Greece and Rome, the Middle Ages, the Renaissance and the Reformation up to 1648.

exams.name: CLEP Western Civilization II: 1648 to the Present
exams.blurb: Credit-by-exam test covering European history from the mid-seventeenth century through the world wars and the post-1945 period.

exams.name: AP 2-D Art and Design
exams.blurb: Portfolio-based AP assessment in two-dimensional design where students submit a sustained investigation and selected works instead of a written exam.

exams.name: AP 3-D Art and Design
exams.blurb: Portfolio-based AP assessment in three-dimensional design in which students submit sculptural and spatial works rather than sitting a written exam.

exams.name: AP African American Studies
exams.blurb: Interdisciplinary AP exam rolled out nationally in 2024 covering African American history, literature, politics and culture from African origins to today.
